page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is a GPU-accelerated virtual server deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is built on an x86_64 processor architecture offering 2 dedicated vCPUs paired with 8.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single dedicated NVIDIA P4 graphics processing unit equipped with 8 GB of video RAM.

Network throughput is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included in the base deployment. The server features no local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for operating system images and data workloads. This architectural boundary necessitates reliance on remote cloud disks for persistent I/O operations.

With its dedicated hardware pairing of an NVIDIA P4 accelerator and modest CPU capacity, the instance targets entry-level GPU tasks. It provides a cost-effective footprint for specialized workloads such as low-concurrency deep learning inference, video transcoding, visual computing, and GPU-assisted batch processing jobs where higher-tier accelerators would introduce resource underutilization.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. It provides 2 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 4.0 GB per vCPU resource ratio. Acceleration is handled by an integrated NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance operates with a 1 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile and contains no local storage, requiring external cloud block storage for persistent data volumes. By combining a light host CPU and memory footprint with dedicated Pascal-generation acceleration, ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large delivers cost-efficient hardware access for lightweight deep learning inference, graphical processing, and parallelized visual computing tasks.
